components.rationale: All three listed subcomponents (GOAL-01..03) are supplied at proved standing on the active reader: separate named lemmas for symmetry, transitivity, function congruence, relation congruence and term substitutivity (P1 body lines 122-165) with written annex derivations (P1 annex 16-127); the equality-axiom set, the calculus ND^- without equality rules, and three equality-axiom metatheorems (P1 body 196-288) with written proofs (P1 annex 129-452). The original note 'symmetry an unlabeled example; transitivity an exercise' is answered by labeled lemmas. The P2 host section sec:p02-fol-equality-metatheory (P2 body 14-49) states the bundled thm:p02-equality-laws with a written annex proof (P2 annex 8-19) and routes by \cref to the free-standing results; the congruence lemma is free-standing, not relative to a maximal consistent set (P1 body 116-120, 167-172). Route: handbook/main.tex:29 \input{parts/p01} -> handbook/parts/p01.tex:53; main.tex:54 \input{annex/p01-route} -> handbook/annex/p01-route.tex:18; main.tex:30 -> handbook/parts/p02.tex:83; main.tex:55 -> handbook/annex/p02.tex:32.

Separate named results: hblemma thm:p01-w02-p01-025-symmetry (122-125), thm:p01-w02-p01-025-transitivity (127-130), thm:p01-w02-p01-025-fun-cong (132-144), thm:p01-w02-p01-025-rel-cong (146-159), thm:p01-w02-p01-025-term-subst (161-165, which identifies formula substitutivity with the primitive =E). Each is a distinct labeled statement with proved= pointer, not an example or exercise. Route: handbook/main.tex:29 \input{parts/p01} -> handbook/parts/p01.tex:53; main.tex:54 \input{annex/p01-route} -> handbook/annex/p01-route.tex:18; main.tex:30 -> handbook/parts/p02.tex:83; main.tex:55 -> handbook/annex/p02.tex:32.

Selected signature fixed with function symbols F and relation symbols R of arity n including nullary cases, identity primitive and logical (convention 95-114); exact function congruence schema (132-144) and relation congruence schema including the identity sign (146-159), with n=0 cases; axiom forms of both schemas displayed in def:p01-w02-p01-025-eq-axioms (199-237), with nullary cases and alpha-variant closure. Route: handbook/main.tex:29 \input{parts/p01} -> handbook/parts/p01.tex:53; main.tex:54 \input{annex/p01-route} -> handbook/annex/p01-route.tex:18; main.tex:30 -> handbook/parts/p02.tex:83; main.tex:55 -> handbook/annex/p02.tex:32.

Derivations written step by step in the annex: symmetry (16-31), transitivity (33-47), function congruence by explicit D_k construction (49-83), relation congruence including identity (85-109), term substitutivity by induction (111-127). Equality-axiom metatheorems stated under the actual ND_FOL conventions (convention 95-114, citing sec:fol-deduction-01; ND^- defined at 231-236): axioms derivable (252-255), replacement from the axioms (257-266), equal strength of rules and axioms (268-288); proofs written in annex 129-153, 156-396 (claims A-H and the main induction including both quantifier cases), 399-451 (both directions, rule-by-rule translation including eigenvariable cases). The P2 bundled theorem's annex proof (P2 annex 8-19) is also written.
